Name: Build and Place Anything Anywhere
Author: FreakinMyShit
TagLine: Build & Place Anything Anywhere lets you build anywhere, place furniture anywhere, and farm anywhere! Also adds the greenhouse as a blueprint to build and more!
Description:
#### If you have any issues, please report them on Nexus

![Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/installation.png "Installation")
* Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)
* Download this mod and unzip it into **`Stardew Valley/Mods`**
* Run the game using SMAPI.
![How To Use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/how-to-use.png "How To Use")
Press the **Comma** or **Period** keys to open up the carpenter or wizard build menus. Select where you want to start building and done! 
For placing furniture/objects, simply place it down where you want. 

If you want to build or place in a disallowed spot, open the [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) and enable **Build Anywhere** or **Place Anywhere** respectively.

Press the **Left Shift** key while building, upgrading or destroying buildings to build/upgrade/destroy more than one building without getting kicked out of the menu.

All the "cheating" options are disabled by default so make sure you look through the config and enable what you want/need!

### [Click here for a full list with descriptions of all the config options!](https://github.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/blob/main/README.md)

![Frequently Asked Questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/frequently-asked-questions.png "Frequently Asked Questions")
**Can I uninstall without issue?**
* Yes, any buildings built outside of the farm map will still function as well.
**Can you build greenhouses with this mod?**
* Yes, you can build the greenhouse as long as you have the greenhouse unlocked. This can be disabled in the settings.
**Does this work with casks as well?**
* Yes, you can enable placing casks as well by turning on the "Cask Functionality" toggle in the "Misc" category.
**Can fruit trees be planted right next to each other?**
* Yes, the "Fruit Tree Tweaks" toggle in the "Farming" category will remove fruit tree growth restrictions.
![Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/compatibility.png "Compatibility")
* Stardew Valley 1.6.0 or later.
* Singleplayer and Multiplayer (even if other players don’t have it).
* Mods that add new blueprints
![Mod Conflicts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/mod-conflicts.png "Mod Conflicts")
* Alternative Textures: both mods will work fine, but you can’t change the skins of buildings outside of the farm.
* Better Junimos: Doesn't work outside of the farm and will spam harmless errors when opening the wizard build menu.
![Current Limitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/current-limitations.png "Current Limitations")
* Jukebox still won’t work in the rain.
* Can't move buildings from one map to another
